soft.overview:
SocietyPress is a free, open-source membership platform built specifically for genealogical and historical societies — the kind run by volunteers, on a shoestring, with no technical staff.

It replaces the tangle of spreadsheets, mailing lists and aging hosted services most societies rely on with one coherent website: members and dues, an events calendar, a research library, genealogical record collections, newsletters, volunteers, donations, a store, elections, and more. Everything is managed from a single admin area designed around the tasks a board member actually performs, not around the software's internal structure.

SocietyPress is built on WordPress and licensed GPL-2.0-or-later. There is no paid tier, no upsell, and no feature held back — a society that installs it gets the whole product, and owns its own data.
soft.features:
• Members and dues — membership tiers, joint memberships, renewals, lapse handling, and a self-service member portal with an editable directory.
  • Events and calendar — registration, waitlists, speaker management, recurring events, iCal feeds, and paid tickets through Stripe or PayPal.
  • Research library — an OPAC-style catalog with categories, reading lists, and automatic cover art from Open Library.
  • Genealogical records — searchable cemetery, census, church and probate collections, with GENRECORD and GEDCOM import and export.
  • Surname research database — Soundex and Metaphone phonetic matching so a misspelled family name still finds its record.
  • Lineage programs — First Families, Pioneer Settlers and the like, with an application workflow, a public roster, and printable certificates.
  • Newsletters and documents — a PDF archive with automatic cover thumbnails, plus a permissioned document library for board and committee papers.
  • Volunteers and governance — officer positions, committees with their own chair dashboards, meeting minutes, volunteer opportunities and hours tracking.
  • Donations and campaigns — one-time, monthly and annual giving through Stripe, one-time through PayPal, with campaign progress bars, a cover-the-fee option and automatic receipts.
  • Online store — sell publications and merchandise with a cart, per-item shipping, Stripe checkout and PayPal Smart Buttons.
  • Voting and elections — secure ballots with tier-based eligibility and published results.
  • Research help and paid research — a public help-request forum with email-verified submission and accept-as-answer, plus optional Stripe-billed research cases with a researcher dashboard.
  • Blast email — segmented mailings to members from inside the site, with delivery logging.
  • Photo gallery and forms — moderated member-submitted images and a builder for arbitrary society forms.
  • Page builder — 40 widget types, so a volunteer can lay out pages without touching code or a block editor.
  • Five child themes plus a theme gallery — Coastline, Heritage, Ledger, Parlor and Prairie, with importable design presets and a theme exchange between societies.
  • Delegated permissions — 10 access areas across 8 role templates, so the treasurer sees finances and the librarian sees the catalog.
  • 18 toggleable modules — turn off what your society does not do, so volunteers are never shown a screen they do not need.
  • Your data stays yours — one-click full-site export, GDPR exporters and erasers, encrypted storage of sensitive member fields, and no external service dependencies.

languages.english-exp_db_pre: The prefix added to every database table name. Leave this alone unless you are installing more than one site into the same database.
languages.english-exp_site_name: The name of your website, shown in the browser tab and at the top of every page.
languages.english-exp_site_desc: A short tagline shown beneath your site name. You can change this later.
languages.english-exp_org_set: Details about your genealogical or historical society. These appear on receipts, membership cards and outgoing email. All of them can be changed later under SocietyPress → Settings.
languages.english-exp_org_name: The full legal or commonly used name of your society, for example "Bexar County Genealogical Society".
languages.english-exp_org_email: The address members should reply to. Leave blank to use the administrator address below.
languages.english-exp_ad_act: The login for whoever manages the website — usually the webmaster or a board member.
languages.english-exp_ad_email: Password resets and important site notices are sent here.
languages.english-exp_no_search_engine:
If checked, this asks search engines not to list your site. Most societies want to be found, so leave this unchecked unless you are still building the site. It is up to search engines to honour the request.
This can be changed later under Settings → Reading.
languages.english-err_adpass_short: The administrator password must be at least 8 characters long.
languages.english-err_ademail: Please enter a valid administrator email address.
